examples.chinese: 我們學校旁邊有一家電影院。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.english: There is a movie theater next to our school.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

items.wordHook: 電(electric) + 影(image) + 院(hall) → an electric-image hall, a movie theater.

examples.chinese: 他要從他家走路去學校。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào cóng tā jiā zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: He wants to walk from his home to school.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
examples.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我想走路去一定沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zǒulù qù yídìng méi wèntí.
examples.english: I think it will certainly be okay going there on foot.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 走路跟騎腳踏車的時候，我們都要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zǒulù gēn qí jiǎotàchē de shíhòu, wǒmen dōu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: When walking and riding a bicycle, we all need to be careful.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 你往前走，過第二個十字路口，就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, guò dì èr ge shízì lùkǒu, jiù dào le.
examples.english: Go straight ahead, pass the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

items.wordHook: 走(walk) + 路(road) → walking along the road: 走路(to go on foot).

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 我是家中第二個兒子，大哥比我大三歲，平常相處得還不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì jiā zhōng dì èr gè érzi, dàgē bǐ wǒ dà sān suì, píngcháng xiāngchǔ de hái bùcuò.
examples.english: I am the second son in the family; my eldest brother is three years older than me, and we get along quite well normally.

examples.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
examples.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
examples.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

items.wordHook: Combining 相(mutual) and 處(reside at): 相處 means get along with.

examples.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The stationery store sells many kinds of stationery, such as pens, backpacks, notebooks, and other student supplies; not only is the quality good, but the price is also not expensive.

items.wordHook: Combining 書(book) and 包(pack): 書包 means schoolbag.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

items.wordHook: Combining 水(water) and 平(flat): 水平 means level.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒujī yā huài le, wǒ yào tā mǎi yī zhī péi wǒ.
examples.english: He pressed my phone and broke it; I want him to buy one to compensate me.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 有位功夫明星的動作很快，一次能踢十幾腿，真的讓人驚訝。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèi gōngfu míngxīng de dòngzuò hěn kuài, yī cì néng tī shí jǐ tuǐ, zhēn de ràng rén jīngyà.
examples.english: A certain kung fu star's moves are very fast; he can kick more than ten times in one go—it really surprises people.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
examples.pinyin: Guānguāngkè dōu shuō Rìběn sìjì de jǐngsè dōu hěn yǒu tèsè, yǒu jīhuì wǒ yào qīnzì qù tǐyàn yíxià.
examples.english: Tourists all say that Japan's scenery in all four seasons is very distinctive; if I have the chance, I want to experience it for myself.

examples.chinese: 我從沒去過澳洲，無法想像那裡的景色有多美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng méi qùguò Àozhōu, wúfǎ xiǎngxiàng nàlǐ de jǐngsè yǒu duō měi.
examples.english: I have never been to Australia and cannot imagine how beautiful the scenery there is.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
examples.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

items.wordHook: Combining 地(earth) and 攤(spread out): 地攤 means stalls.
城(city) + 市(market) → a city is where walls and markets are.
Combining 對(correct) and 象(elephant): 對象 means match, boyfriend or girlfriend, marriage partner.
Combining 攝(absorb) and 影(shadow): 攝影 means film, to take pictures.
Combining 泡(bubble) and 麵(face): 泡麵 means instant noodles.
a 离(rare beast) takes a 隹(bird) leap → flying away from: 離(away from).
